pay.fx.title: Payment details for this purchase
pay.fx.subtotal_pending: Available once every item has a verified price
pay.fx.monthly_note: Each month for {n} months; the last payment may be lower
pay.fx.down_required: Required; the amount is confirmed in store
pay.fx.financed_note: Merchandise only, before tax, delivery and setup
pay.fx.elig_min: Advertised for purchases of {min} or more on one receipt. What counts toward the minimum, and credit approval, are confirmed in store.
pay.fx.elig_below: The merchandise subtotal is below the advertised {min} minimum. What counts toward the minimum is confirmed in store.
pay.fx.elig_cis: Subject to approval; confirmed in store
pay.fx.basis: How this estimate is made: the required payment is {pct}% of the promotional purchase, rounded up to the next whole dollar, as published for this plan. Rounding can make the last payment lower, so the totals shown are the most the scheduled payments can add up to.
pay.fx.estimate: Estimate only, not an offer of credit. It assumes every payment is made on time and nothing else is charged to the account. If tax, delivery or setup are added to the promotional purchase, the payment is higher. Your specialist confirms the final figures.
pay.fx.why_incomplete: Payment figures appear once every item in this purchase has a verified price.
pay.fx.why_below: No payment is estimated while the merchandise subtotal is below the advertised minimum.
pay.fx.why_method: No payment method is published for this option, so payments are confirmed in store.
pay.fx.why_terms: Current terms are confirmed in store.
pay.fx.updated: Payment figures were recalculated for the new purchase.
pay.fx.tax_note: Depends on where the sale and delivery take place
pay.fx.fulfil_pickup_note: Pickup from the central warehouse, as published
pay.fx.fulfil_delivery_note: Delivery and setup charges are confirmed in store
pay.fx.total_note: Merchandise, interest, sales tax, and delivery or setup
pay.fx.excludes_all: Estimate: excludes sales tax and delivery or setup charges, which are still to confirm.
pay.fx.excludes_tax: Estimate: excludes sales tax, which is still to confirm.
pay.ff.title: How it gets home
pay.cp.check_title: What the published conditions ask this sleep system to include
pay.cp.confirm: Your specialist confirms qualification. Adding these items is always your choice.
pay.pb.mattress_unpriced: This mattress has no verified price at {size}, so no subtotal or payment is shown. Your specialist confirms the price.
pay.pb.items_unpriced: {n} selected items have no verified price at {size}, so the complete-system figures are withheld.
pay.pb.compare_title: Mattress only or the complete sleep system
pay.pb.unknown_value: sales tax and delivery or setup (to confirm)
pay.pb.items_unpriced_one: 1 selected item has no verified price at {size}, so the complete-system figures are withheld.
pay.pb.mattress_only_stands: The mattress-only figures are for the mattress on its own.
pay.pb.items_unpriced_some: Some selected items have no verified price, so the complete-system figures are withheld.
pay.fx.min_basis_note: Shown because the merchandise subtotal reaches the advertised {min} minimum. The lender has not published what counts toward the minimum, so this does not confirm eligibility.
pay.sc.title: Try assumptions
pay.sc.intro: Every value entered here is an assumption, not a published fact. Nothing here is saved, sent or shown to customers, and the verified payment details above are not changed.
pay.sc.treat_label: Sales tax and delivery or setup are…
pay.sc.incomplete: Assumptions need every item in this purchase to have a verified price.
pay.sc.chip_today: Assumed: tax and delivery paid today
pay.sc.m_tax: a sales tax rate (enter 0 if none)
pay.sc.m_delivery: a delivery and setup amount (enter 0 if none)
pay.sc.m_down_invalid: a valid down payment (up to the merchandise subtotal)
pay.sc.m_treatment: whether tax and delivery are paid today or financed
pay.sc.treat_hint: Choose whether tax and delivery are paid today or financed to see due today and the amount financed.
pay.sc.r_scheduled: Scheduled payments (maximum, not an exact payoff total)
pay.sc.fine: Assumption-based scenario: not a quote or an offer of credit. Payments use each plan's published method on the scenario's amount financed; minimums are tested against the merchandise subtotal, which does not confirm eligibility. Totals are maximums because rounding can make the last payment lower.
pay.sc.needs_down: Needs a down payment above $0 (published as required)
pay.sc.charges_upfront: Published terms require tax and delivery at purchase; choose paid today
pay.sc.live: Scenario updated. Total due today: {due}. Amount financed: {fin}.
